source_examined.source_basis: Two substantive numbered provisions require review. Machine operative lead is not a separate command. Five days runs from each judgment, not signing. Bond/deposit rules recur. Repealing old sections does not establish cessation of the new appeal regime or residual effects.
unresolved_source_questions: Find first later cessation/replacement of each appeal/security rule and effective date; read repealed sections and transition/savings for pending cases, appeals, bonds and deposits; examine earlier partial changes.

challenges: No blocked disposition is contradicted by the pinned source findings. Specific added later-instrument assertions are unverified as noted; confirmation of the hold does not authenticate those assertions.

EO966 paragraph 2 repeal is completed on issuance; absence of a later cessation does not make that repeal an unperformed command. Continuing paragraph 1 and unresolved transitions still support the whole-case hold.
limits: The eight comparisons use the exact pinned initial independent source examination, not new scientific examinations of the other twenty-two. No unprovided claims reviewed, submitted or approved. No human certification. Genuine EO393 calibration is separate from these thirty outcomes.
